turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon, this is a call from SBI Bank KYC verification team.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Yes, how can I help you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your KYC has not been updated. Your account will be blocked in 24 hours.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: What do I need to do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I will send you a verification code. Please read it out to me immediately.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Okay let me check...

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, I am calling from HDFC Bank. Your account has been flagged for suspicious activity.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: What kind of activity?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We need to verify your identity right now. Please share the OTP that was sent to your phone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not discuss this with anyone. This is a confidential security process.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, I am calling from Axis Bank. Your KYC is incomplete and your account will be suspended in 2 hours.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: How do I complete the KYC?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Tell me the six digit code you received in your text message.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hurry, the request will expire.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am a representative from PNB Bank. Your KYC needs an urgent update.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Alright.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please install AnyDesk application on your phone. I will complete the KYC remotely for you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is a secure government approved process. Do not tell anyone about this call.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Kotak Mahindra Bank. We are calling to inform you that your debit card will be deactivated unless you verify your credentials immediately.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: What credentials?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We need your card number, CVV, and the OTP that will be sent to your phone.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: I am not sure about this.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, you must comply within 10 minutes or the card will be permanently blocked.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, I am Inspector Verma from the Central Bureau of Investigation.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: CBI? What is this about?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A non-bailable warrant has been issued in your name. Your Aadhaar is linked to a drug trafficking case.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You must transfer 50,000 rupees immediately to a safe government account to avoid arrest.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not tell your family or lawyer. Do not disconnect this call. This is a classified investigation.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, I am Inspector Mehta from the Cybercrime Department. You have been implicated in a money laundering case.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: That is impossible. I have not done anything.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We have digital evidence. A non-bailable warrant has been issued in your name.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You must pay a security deposit of 1 lakh rupees immediately to avoid arrest. Do not contact your family or lawyer until the case is resolved.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is the Enforcement Directorate. An illegal transaction has been found linked to your bank account.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: This cannot be true.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We have proof. You must transfer 50,000 rupees to a government account right now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Stay on the line. Do not tell anyone about this call. This is classified.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Mumbai Customs Department. A parcel in your name contains banned substances.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: I never ordered any parcel.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your identity is linked to it. You will be arrested unless you pay a clearance fee of 75,000 rupees right now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not inform anyone. This is an ongoing operation. Stay on the line.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, I am calling from Amazon customer service. We have detected an overcharge of 4,500 rupees on your account.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Oh, really?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes. To process your refund, please scan this QR code from your UPI app. The money will come directly to your account.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: But scanning a QR code is for payment, not receiving.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No sir, this is a special refund QR. Please scan it right now, the offer expires in 5 minutes.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, I am calling from Flipkart. You had a refund of 2,300 rupees that was not processed.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Yes, I was expecting that refund.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am sending a UPI collect request to your phone now. Please approve the collect request to receive your refund.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do it now, it will expire in 2 minutes.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is IRCTC helpline. Your train ticket refund is pending.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Yes, I cancelled the ticket.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To process the refund you will need to scan a QR code. I will send it to you on WhatsApp.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please do it now, the portal closes at night.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Microsoft technical support. We have detected a virus on your computer.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: A virus? What kind?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A very dangerous ransomware. We need to fix it immediately. Please install AnyDesk from the internet.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Once you install, give me the access code shown on screen. Do not close the application.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am calling from your bank fraud prevention team. We have blocked a suspicious transaction.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Yes, what happened?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To reverse the block, I need you to install TeamViewer QuickSupport on your phone right now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Share the 9-digit ID on screen with me. Do not tell anyone else about this call.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, I am from your bank IT security team. Your phone has been hacked.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: What? How do you know?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We are monitoring it. Install AnyDesk right now so I can fix your phone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Give me the number displayed on screen. Do not tell anyone about this.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning! I am calling from WealthPro Investment Advisory. We have an exclusive opportunity with 40 percent guaranteed monthly returns.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: That sounds very high.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, this is available only for the next 24 hours. You need to transfer a minimum of 50,000 rupees to lock in your spot.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not discuss this with anyone, this is an exclusive private invitation.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is SBI fraud prevention. We noticed an unusual transaction of 15,000 rupees from your account.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: That was not me.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We have blocked the transaction for your safety. Please do not share any OTP or PIN with anyone. Visit your nearest branch to verify.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is SBI fraud alert service. A transaction has been detected on your account.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Yes, tell me.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If this transaction was not yours, please call our toll free number 1800112211 or visit your nearest branch.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We never ask for your OTP, PIN, or password. Do not share these with anyone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is ICICI Bank. We are calling regarding your credit card statement.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Yes, go ahead.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your payment is due on the 5th. You can pay through net banking or visit a branch.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please do not share your card PIN or OTP with anyone. Our staff never asks for these.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is BlueDart delivery. Your package with tracking ID BD982341 is out for delivery.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Great, when will it arrive?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It will be delivered between 2 PM and 5 PM today. Is someone available at the address?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Yes, I will be home.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is a public safety announcement. Banks will never ask you to share your OTP over the phone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If anyone asks for your PIN, CVV, or password, hang up and report to cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Stay alert. No real bank officer will ever ask for your OTP on the phone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you receive such a call, hang up immediately and report to 1930.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is an awareness call. Never share your bank PIN or CVV with anyone over the phone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Real bank employees will never ask for this information.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, did you receive an OTP from our system?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Yes I did receive a message.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good, that confirms your registration is complete. No need to share it with anyone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, your son has been in a serious accident. He is in the hospital.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Oh my god, which hospital?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We need 25,000 rupees immediately for the surgery. Send it to this account right now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not call your son yet, he is in the operation theater. Stay on the line.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Congratulations! You have been selected for a data entry position at Google India.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Really? I did not apply.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your resume was found on Naukri.com. To confirm your placement, transfer 5,000 rupees as a registration fee.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This offer is valid only until tonight. Do not share this with anyone or the slot will be given to someone else.
